Also refused by upstream main (7956a884e5, pipx 1.17.13), installed fresh and run normally on Python 3.14.

findings.command: llm python -m pip install --pre torch torchvision --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/nightly/cpu
findings.message: No such option '--pre'. (Did you mean one of: '--key', '--param'?)

findings.command: llm schema dsl name, age int, bio: their bio
findings.message: Got unexpected extra arguments (dsl name, age int, bio: their bio)
findings.reason: `llm schema dsl`: the command is `schemas`
findings.why: The help of `llm schemas dsl` (llm/cli.py, line 2807, copied into docs/help.md) shows `llm schema dsl ...`. There's no schema command, so llm passes the words to its default prompt command, which refuses them ("Got unexpected extra arguments"). Run normally, `llm schemas dsl ...` works. Upstream main is the pinned commit.

findings.reason: a quoted argument that spans several lines, which the reader doesn't join

findings.command: alembic revision -m add ip account table \ --head=networking@head \ --depends-on=55af2cb1c267 --depends-on=d747a --depends-on=fa445
findings.reason: lines end in two backslashes, which the shell doesn't read as a continuation
findings.why: Lines 678 and 679 end in two backslashes inside a literal block, which shows them as written. In a shell, \\ at the end of a line is a backslash, not a continuation: pasted into bash, alembic says "unrecognized arguments: \" and the next two lines run as separate commands that don't exist. Upstream main is the pinned commit.
